requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current and valid license from another jurisdiction and either an NCARB certificate, or the other jurisdiction's requirements must be determined equivalent to Maine's requirements. Licensure by endorsement process also available under 32 §220-D.
requirements.quote: An architect license may be issued without examination to an applicant who holds a current and valid license from another jurisdiction provided the requirements for the license are determined equivalent to requirements for licensure by examination in this State and the applicant submits other evidence of ability as may be required by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The board may deny a license or refuse to renew a license for reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5-A, paragraph A.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may deny a license, refuse to renew a license or impose the disciplinary sanctions authorized by Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A for any of the reasons enumerated in Title 10, section 8003, subsection 5‑A, paragraph A.

definition_quote.value: the practice of architecture consists of rendering or offering to render service to clients by consultations, investigations, technical submissions and a coordination of structural factors concerning the aesthetic or structural design and administration of construction contracts or any other service in connection with the designing or administration of construction contracts for buildings located inside the State that have as their principal purpose human occupancy or habitation, regardless of whether the persons are performing one or all of these duties, or whether they are performed in person or as the directing head of an office or organization performing them.

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: A person may not use the title "certified interior designer" unless licensed under this chapter. This chapter does not prohibit a person from providing interior design services or from using the title "interior designer."

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Interior design services" means services that do not require the services of a licensed architect or engineer and that involve the preparation of working drawings, plans and specifications relative to building elements that are not necessary for the structural stability and mechanical and electrical integrity of the construction.

value: individual only — no firm, corporation, company, partnership or limited liability company
permitted_firm_structures.quote: A firm, corporation, company, partnership or limited liability company may not be licensed under this chapter.

seal_required.quote: Each licensed architect or landscape architect shall upon licensure obtain a seal of such design as the board authorizes and directs. Technical submissions prepared by or under the direct supervision of a licensed architect or under the direct supervision of a licensed landscape architect must be stamped with the seal during the life of the licensee's license.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It is unlawful for anyone to stamp or seal any documents with the seal after the license named on the seal has expired or has been revoked, unless the license has been renewed or reissued.

value: initial licensee exempt for 2 years if not previously licensed in any jurisdiction for 2 or more years
continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: An architect who receives an initial license to practice architecture from any jurisdiction, including a foreign jurisdiction, is exempt from the requirements of subsection 1 for 2 years from the date of issuance of that initial license, as long as the architect has not been previously licensed by any jurisdiction, including a foreign jurisdiction, for a period of 2 or more years.
